findings.recommendation: Replace the line with a real shell command for re-running the audit, or move the non-shell invocation syntax out of the powershell fence.

findings.finding: The skill contains conditional remediation behavior, but it is described only in prose bullets.
findings.recommendation: Use an explicit decision flow such as `If findings exist -> ask whether to run skill-update; otherwise report PASS and stop.`
